Which region satisfies all three inequalities?

Region [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text: Test one point from a region in all three inequalities. A point in region {@Rl@}, for example \(({@regs[Rj][2]@}, {@regs[Rj][3]@})\), makes all three true: it is on the correct side of every line, so region {@Rl@} satisfies all three. Every other region is on the wrong side of at least one line.

questiondescription.text:
Linear Inequalities: which region satisfies three inequalities

Grade 12 CBE Essential 1.3: Identify the region that satisfies three linear inequalities among seven labelled regions.

Essential

This question is adapted from Chapter 1 (Graphing inequalities), questions B5(a) and D1(a) of Ling, J., Scruton, P., Shilton, S. and West, H., SMP GCSE Mathematics: Higher 2 for AQA, Edexcel and OCR two-tier GCSE mathematics, Cambridge University Press, 2007: new systems with a sloping boundary, seven labelled regions and no shading.

truefeedback.text: Points in region {@ans1@} make {@fstr@} false, so they are on its unwanted side.
